main.content: --| Lua module for processing crafting station levels --$Id: 202306090001-wip --b a surly Dvergr codesmith --TODO more stuff, eventually local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs local p = {} local stations = require('Module:Crafting station/data') local fmt_long = '%s (not yet available)' local fmt_short = '%s' -- Helper function for determining if a given flag is set -- in a function's arguments local isFlagSet = function(flag) if flag then local word = tostring(flag) return #word > 0 and tostring(flag) ~= 'false' and tostring(flag):sub(1, 1):lower() ~= 'n' else return false end end local str_escape = function(str) return str:gsub("[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]", "%%%1") end -- pattern-less substring replacement (like string.gsub but without patterns) local str_replace = function (str, this, that) local newThat = string.gsub(that, "%%", "%%%%") return string.gsub(str, str_escape(this), newThat) -- apparently, only % needs to be escaped here end local doCell = function(args) local byHand = isFlagSet(args['by hand']) local short = isFlagSet(args.short) local station = args.station if not station then station = args[1] end station = tostring(station):lower() local curLvl = args.level if not curLvl then curLvl = args[2] end curLvl = tonumber(curLvl) local lvlText = tostring(curLvl) if byHand and curLvl <= 1 then if not short then lvlText = 'Not required' else lvlText = 'By hand' end end local maxLvl = nil if stations[station] ~= nil then maxLvl = #stations[station] + 1 end if not curLvl or (maxLvl and curLvl <= maxLvl) then return lvlText elseif not short then return string.format(fmt_long, lvlText) else return string.format(fmt_short, lvlText) end end --% Prints a formatted crafting station level number --@ 1 (string) The crafting station (alias: "station") --@ 2 (number) The level of the crafting station to print (alias: "level") --@ byZhand (boolean) ("by hand") True if the item is craftable by hand at level 1, else false --@ short (boolean) True to use shorthand formatting for cell contents (omits the "currently unobtainable" notice), else false --: (string) Wikitext function p.cell(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) return doCell(args) end local doRow = function(args) local byHand = isFlagSet(args['by hand']) local short = isFlagSet(args.short) local link = isFlagSet(args.link) local station = args.station if not station then station = args[1] end station = tostring(station):lower() local stationDisp = station if #station > 1 then stationDisp = station:gsub("%S+", function(word) return word:sub(1, 1):upper() .. word:sub(2) end) end local colspan = args.colspan colspan = tonumber(colspan) if not colspan then colspan = 1 end local levels = args.levels if not levels then levels = args[2] end levels = tonumber(levels) if not levels or (levels < 1) or (levels > 10) then return 'Template error: Invalid level range' end local start = args.start start = tonumber(start) if not start or (start < 1) then start = 1 end local result = '|-"vertical-align:middle;"\n' result = result .. '! colspan="' .. tostring(colspan) .. '" | ' if link then result = result .. '[[' .. stationDisp .. ']]' else result = result .. stationDisp end result = result .. ' level\n' local doLvl = start for i=1,levels do local incr = 0 local sep = '| ' if i > 1 then incr = 1 sep = ' || ' end local newLvl = nil if args['level '..tostring(i)] then local tmpLvl = tonumber(args['level '..tostring(i)]) if tmpLvl then newLvl = tmpLvl end end if newLvl then doLvl = newLvl else doLvl = doLvl + incr end local tbl = { byHand = byHand, short = short, station = station, level = doLvl } local res = doCell(tbl) result = result .. sep .. res end if args.addcol then for i=1, args.addcol do result = result .. "|| " end end return result .. '\n|-' end --% Prints a table row containing a given number of formatted crafting row cells --@ 1 (string) The crafting station (alias: "station") --@ 2 (number) The number of level cells to print (alias: "levels") --@ start (number) The level to start at --@ byZhand (boolean) ("by hand") True if the item is craftable by hand at level 1, else false --@ short (boolean) True to use shorthand formatting for cell contents (omits the "currently unobtainable" notice), else false --@ link (boolean) True to print the crafting station name as a link, else false --@ colspan (number) The colspan of the row header to print (defaults to 1 if omitted) --@ levelY (number) ("level #" for some #) Level number to display in the #th cell (will be automatically determined if omitted) --@ addcol (number) Add any number of columns at the end of the row --: (string) Wikitext function p.row(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) return doRow(args) end --% Returns the maximum crafting level currently attainable for the given crafting station. --@ 1 (string) The crafting station (alias: "station") --: (string) The maximum crafting level for the station, or "???" if no station was found by that name. function p.maxLevel(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) local station = args.station if not station then station = args[1] end station = tostring(station):lower() local maxLvl = nil if stations[station] ~= nil then maxLvl = #stations[station] + 1 end if maxLvl then return tostring(maxLvl) else return '???' end end --% Returns the crafting station that the given upgrade piece belongs to. --@ 1 (string) The crafting station upgrade name, case-insensitive (e.g. "tanning rack") --: (string) The name, in lower case, of the crafting station which the piece improves, or an empty string if the piece is not a crafting station improvement. function p.getParentStation(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) local piece = args[1] piece = tostring(piece):lower() for k, v in pairs(stations) do if v ~= nil then for i=1,#v do if string.lower(v[i]) == piece then return k end end end end return '' end --% Returns a delimited list of the lower-case names of each upgrade to the given crafting station. --@ 1 (string) The crafting station name (alias: "station") --@ 2 (string) The delimiter to use, defaults to a single comma (alias: "sep") --@ pretty (boolean) True to format the names in start case, else uppercase --@ key (string) The key to search and replace in the "format" param (if specified): -- Each name will be formatted by appending the format, with all instances of -- this key replaced with a station improvement name, to the resulting string. --@ format (string) The format to use when appending names to the list (see "key"). --: (string) A delimited list of improvement names. function p.getUpgrades(frame) local args = getArgs(frame) local station = args.station if not station then station = args[1] end station = tostring(station):lower() local sep = args.sep if not sep then sep = args[2] end if not sep then sep = ',' end local pretty = isFlagSet(args.pretty) local sformat = args['format'] local skey = args.key if not skey or #skey < 1 then skey = '@@@@' end if not sformat or #sformat < 1 then sformat = skey end local result = '' if stations[station] ~= nil then for i=1,#stations[station] do if i > 1 then result = result .. sep end local cur = stations[station][i] if pretty then if #cur > 1 then cur = cur:gsub("%S+", function(word) if word == "and" then return word end return word:sub(1, 1):upper() .. word:sub(2) end) else cur = string.upper(cur) end end result = result .. str_replace(sformat, skey, cur) end end return result end return p
